detail: Paper dry-run must explicitly keep live order submission disabled.
Paper summary JSON is the run manifest for the dry-run.
A 20-day simulation target should be recorded when requested.
No orders can be valid after risk/targets, but order evidence should be visible.
Risk checks must write row-level order evidence.
Summary pass/fail should match row-level risk report.
Risk-passed paper orders must write simulated executions.
Risk-passed paper orders must write simulated positions, even if flat.
PaperBroker executions should be simulated fills, not live broker statuses.
Each generated order should have a simulated execution row.
Paper fills must preserve cost fields.
Dry-run execution must use PaperBroker only.
Paper order planning must record portfolio constraint metadata.
Paper order planning should record event-risk guard state.
